gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-anuphan: Commanding vintage swagger comes from Woodgod, with tall lowercase letters that nearly touch the capitals. Anuphan, a plain sans, follows with big round bowls and open curves, and the two together read as bold and friendly.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-arimo: Woodgod cuts a wide channel into every bowl, giving the display lettering a vintage, commanding look. Arimo, a sans-serif with a tall mean line, then adds rounded glyphs with spacious terminal gaps.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-armata: Vintage muscle meets modern restraint here, with Woodgod up top, its lowercase rising close to the capitals, and Armata beneath. Woodgod makes the statement while the plain sans Armata fills out its letter height.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-athiti: Woodgod's low diagonals look lighter than its verticals, which gives its tall lowercase a distinctive, vintage, commanding bite. It earns its keep big and short, while Athiti keeps a high mean line.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-atkinson-hyperlegi: Atkinson Hyperlegible reads approachably, with capitals and ascenders that feel clipped beside its lowercase and wide-set terminals on the s. Woodgod earns its keep big and short, bringing vintage command.

Woodgod's wide channel into every bowl and lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals give it a commanding, vintage stance. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono, a sans, stretches its spacing open like stencil bridges, letting counters breathe.
Approachable and contemporary, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next has lowercase eyes as big as washers and rounds left unsealed like an unlatched hook. Woodgod adds vintage command above them.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-biryani: Woodgod's wide channel into every bowl makes its tall, vintage lowercase unmistakable, a commanding look cut with low-contrast strokes. Biryani, a sans-serif with large clear e eyes, would feel stranger if Woodgod went small.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-blinker: Woodgod brings a commanding, vintage voice, with a wide channel cut into every bowl and tall lowercase rising near the capitals. Blinker, a plain sans, keeps horizontal bars exactly as heavy as its stems, so paragraphs flow smoothly.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-carrois-gothic: Carrois Gothic brings a modern, professional tone, with a high-set x-height and a generous opening in c. And Woodgod, with its wide bowl channels and tall lowercase, gives the pair a vintage, commanding edge.
